statement: Plunderous mob spawn chance for Siege Breaker raised from 1% to 2%.
Guaranteed plunderous mob spawn after no spawn now comes at 40 kills instead of 90.
Getting to 10000 plunderous mob kills for extra drop rate should now be much easier.
Update gives 8 free storage spots.
Steam charts show a big rise in accounts and active players; not counting iOS or Android.
New premium sorcerer hat gives 5% all stat and is one of the strongest premium hats available.
Limited shop has cosmic candy; one free World 4 card pack and a discounted World 5 card pack.
Limited shop sells a 25% drop rate keychain and you can buy two; he calls it a menace.
With the keychain-doubling chip and both keychains equipped it is 75% drop rate from keychains alone.
No better drop rate keychain exists; buy both if you have the gems.
Elemental Sorcerer is the new class in the Wizard tab.
Mana's Life talent reworked to give multi-kill per tier instead of mana regen percent.
Meteor shower drops meteors that increase damage; 40 to 45 meteors depending on level; huge AOE.
Lightning barrage hits 11 to 12 mobs when leveled and adds about 2000% increased damage.
Radiant chain bolt bounces up to about 25 times but loses damage per hit; good for clearing different platforms.
Elemental Sorcerer is an AOE legend.
Basic attacks may create a tornado or volcano (Wizard spells) or fireball (Mage); scales with levels of those talents.
Dimensional Wormhole spawns wormhole mobs that start small then grow bigger and stronger with more XP and drops.
Wormhole is a respawn mechanic like Siege Breaker's Pirate Flag and Divine Knight's divine intervention.
Wormhole Emperor gives total damage percent based on power of 10 to all characters as a multiplicative bonus.
Best place to farm portal kills per hour is green spores at about 256 portal kills per reset.
Polytheism gives more divinity points and lets two gods run on the Elemental Sorcerer; gods swap each time a talent point is put in.
Change gods without a talent reset by standing under the elephant god which refunds the points.
God pairings possible include Arctis the bear god; Mantis for double kills; Arcus or goat; and hair; rest garbled.
Family bonus is one of the strongest; increases max talent level if you have one point in it.
Sorcerer is pretty strong in party dungeons but not as strong as Divine Knight.
Sorcerer's only issue in party dungeons is a huge mana problem.
Elemental Sorcerer is one of his new favorites besides Maestro; he loves Maestro more.
Active play style with choices is a step in the right direction; game is becoming more second-monitor content.
World 5 is his new favorite world; he has played since early World 3.
